VI.description: Round20 P6 flagship: a top-level VI orchestrating two subVIs through Call nodes - Accumulate N.vi (While Loop + 2 shift registers, Sum/Count) and Mean Of Pair.vi (Divide). Data crosses connector panes twice: N in, Sum/Count/Mean out. Expected outputs, hand-computed: N=5 gives Sum=15, Count=5, Mean=3.0; N=3 gives Sum=6, Count=3, Mean=2.0. The int-to-DBL promotion happens inside Mean Of Pair and crosses the caller's pane as DBL. Call output net ids are their own numbers (not the Call node's uid), per the round-6 recipe.
